payload.question: Give me detailed list of All india Cooperatives
payload.sql: SELECT c.category, COALESCE(t.cnt,0) AS count FROM (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category UNION ALL SELECT 'State Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regional Federation' UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'District Cooperative Banks' UNION ALL SELECT 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' UNION ALL SELECT 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)') c LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Primary Cooperatives' AS category, COUNT(*) cnt FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved = 1 AND is_multi_state=0 UNION ALL SELECT federation_type_name AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_district_federation where status = 1 AND is_draft = 0 AND is_approved = 0 AND federation_type_name IN ('State Federation','District Federation','Block/Taluka/Mandal Federation','Regional Federation') GROUP BY federation_type_name UNION ALL SELECT 'Multistate Cooperative' AS category, COUNT(*) FROM cooperative_master_chatbot_tbl WHERE status=1 AND is_draft=0 AND is_approved <> 2 AND is_multi_state=1 UNION ALL SELECT CASE bank_level WHEN 'SCB' THEN 'State Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'DCB' THEN 'District Cooperative Banks' WHEN 'PCARDB' THEN 'Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (PCARDB)' WHEN 'SCARDB' THEN 'State Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Banks (SCARDB)' END AS category, COUNT(*) FROM chatbot_state_cooperative_banks WHERE status=1 AND is_delete=0 AND is_draft <> 1 GROUP BY bank_level) t ON LOWER(TRIM(c.category)) = LOWER(TRIM(t.category));
